## Royal Gold Strengthens Board of Directors with Appointment of Experienced Mining Executive Harry Kenyon-Slaney and Recommendation for Declassification


11/18/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 118 KB](https://s28.q4cdn.com/583965976/files/doc_news/Royal-Gold-Strengthens-Board-of-Directors-with-Appointment-of-Experienced-Mining-Executive-Harry-Kenyon-Slaney-and-Recommendation-for-7AKXC.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**Royal Gold, Inc. (NASDAQ: RGLD)** (together with its subsidiaries, “Royal Gold,” the “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) announced today the appointment of Mr. Harry Kenyon-Slaney as an independent member to the Board of Directors (the “Board”) effective immediately, increasing the size of the Board to eight Directors. A former member of Rio Tinto’s Group Executive Committee, Mr. Kenyon-Slaney adds to the Board’s significant mining industry expertise. Additionally, the Board is recommending an amendment to our certificate of incorporation to declassify the Board following our 2027 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the “Annual Meeting”).


*“Royal Gold has a strong Board of Directors with the experience required to provide leadership and oversight in our unique business,”* commented Bill Hayes, Chairman of Royal Gold. *“Harry adds to that strength with a perspective earned through a four-decade career in operating, commercial and C-suite roles. Investing in streams and royalties requires many skills, including an understanding of the fundamentals of mining assets, and his broad and firsthand knowledge of mining is especially valuable. The Board and I look forward to his contributions as we continue to execute our growth strategy. With the addition of Harry as another independent Director as well as the potential declassification of the Board, we are enhancing our already strong governance practices.”*


Mr. Kenyon-Slaney has over 40 years of experience in the mining industry, including a 25-year career with Rio Tinto, where he served as Chief Executive, Energy, and Chief Executive, Diamonds and Minerals, and was a member of the Group Executive Committee from 2009 to 2015. His earlier positions included Managing Director of Rio Tinto Iron & Titanium, Chief Executive Officer of Rio Tinto’s listed subsidiary Energy Resources of Australia Limited, and General Manager, Operations, at Palabora Mining Company in South Africa before which Mr. Kenyon-Slaney held senior marketing roles in copper, uranium and industrial minerals. He began his career as an underground geologist with Anglo American in South Africa.


Mr. Kenyon-Slaney serves as Lead Independent Director of Sibanye-Stillwater Limited, where he has been a director since January 2019, and as Senior Independent Director of WE Soda Ltd. He has also served on the advisory boards of Phoenix Copper Limited and Enertechnos and was a Senior Advisor to McKinsey & Company from 2015 to 2024. Mr. Kenyon-Slaney previously served as Chair of Gem Diamonds Limited from 2017 to 2026, as a director of Bridon Bekaert The Ropes Group from 2016 to 2018 and as a member of the advisory board of Schenck Process from 2017 until its sale in 2023.


**Declassification of the Board of Directors**


On November 18, 2026, the Board approved an amendment to our certificate of incorporation to declassify the Board, and will submit the amendment for approval at our 2027 Annual Meeting. The Board action followed a review of trends in board classification, investor feedback, and other governance matters. Our Board is currently divided into three classes, with each class serving a staggered three-year term. If the charter amendment is approved by a majority of our stockholders at the Annual Meeting, the Board will be fully declassified, with all directors standing for election annually, beginning at our 2030 Annual Meeting.


**Corporate Profile**


Royal Gold is a high-margin, large-capitalization company that generates strong cash flows from a large and well-diversified portfolio of precious metal streams, royalties and similar production-based interests located in mining-friendly jurisdictions. Royal Gold shares trade under the symbol “RGLD” and provide growth, value, and income investors exposure to the metals & mining industry. The Company’s website is located at[www.royalgold.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.royalgold.com&esheet=54643652&newsitemid=20261118002519&lan=en-US&anchor=www.royalgold.com&index=1&md5=524861e16479b8308d384cd5164eb151) .

Royal Gold and its directors and certain of its executive officers are participants in the solicitation of proxies in connection with the Annual Meeting. Information about the participants and their interests in Royal Gold is available in (i) Royal Gold’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, filed with the SEC on February 19, 2026, (ii) Royal Gold’s proxy statement for its 2026 Annual Meeting, filed with the SEC on April 3, 2026, and (iii) the Forms 4 filed by William Heissenbuttel on September 8, 2026 and October 6, 2026.
